about.introTemplate: I'm a backend and platform engineer with {{years}}+ years of experience, most recently as a tech lead and platform engineer in fintech, payments and telecom. I build TypeScript/NestJS systems on AWS and Kubernetes and make them easy to run: observability, CI/CD, security gates, and a developer experience that lets teams ship fast without breaking production.

expanded.html: Most recently at Odido (via NestDev): structured logging and Elastic dashboards across the customer self-service platform, personal-data redaction in logs, supply-chain security gates in CI, and account and authentication features end to end.

items: Bitvavo – Tech Lead: led the migration of a large multi-service platform from JavaScript to TypeScript with NestJS, GraphQL Federation and React, plus hiring, coaching and sprint management.
Embed (ex Fung Payments) – Platform Engineer: event-driven AWS platform (Lambda, Fargate, SQS/SNS), CDK infrastructure as code, observability and PCI DSS.
Game7 – Tech Lead: backend architecture, developer experience and the infrastructure behind a large-scale MMORPG.

expanded.html: Founder and lead developer of AzerothCore, an open-source, modular MMO server framework in C++ started in 2016: 8,900+ stars, 3,800+ forks and 600+ contributors, used in production by public game servers.
Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL/MySQL, AWS (CDK, Lambda, ECS/Fargate), Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Elastic/Kibana. Also C++ and Java.
Open to contract and full-time roles · Haarlem, NL · remote-first.
